correctness.rationale: For the cyclic binary constraint prohibiting triple 000 and111, allowed order-two de Bruijn graph has six arcs 001,010,011,100,101,110. Flow balance forces profile (a,s-b,b,a,s-a,b), s>=1, 0<=a,b<=s, n=2s+a+b. Mark an occurrence of vertex 01 (exactly s such indices), traverse s outward 01-to-10 and return 10-to-01 excursions, with independent binary detour choices in exactly b outward and a return legs. There are C(s,a)C(s,b) marked walks; double-counting (word,index) gives n/s times this product, no disconnected Euler-support exception. At fixed s, log-concavity balances a,b; feasible s range ceil(n/4)..floor(n/2), so stated finite max holds for every n>=2. Independent direct complete profile enumeration of 5,774 valid indexed cyclic words n=2..16 agrees. At n=2 the two alternating words correctly form a fiber of size 2.
